description: Default English phrase banks for the front model and the policy engine. Groups owned by W2 feed the per-decision compose grammar (the model can only speak these fragments and copy spans of the caller's words); groups owned by W4 are clips the policy engine plays without a model call (W4 section 3.13.3). Every group is persona-overridable: PersonaSpec.banks.<group> replaces the default list for that persona, and the replacement is checked by the same validator and fact guard at compile time. '{{org}}' and '{{name}}' are the only slots a bank line may carry; they are filled from the persona at compile time and are protected terms.

line_flags.polar: the line starts by affirming or denying; never offered or picked when the caller's newest utterance is a yes/no question, except a social line used for its own intent
line_flags.signed: operator-signed line that bypasses the entity rules (logged at startup); refused for tenant personas
line_flags.acts: the front acts whose grammar may use this line or fragment
line_flags.intent: social intent of a social line, used by the social_line_matches_intent rule

kinds.fragment: a piece the compose grammar joins with other pieces; no final punctuation
kinds.line: a whole line the grammar offers as one alternative
kinds.clip: a whole line W4 plays as pre-rendered audio, without a model call

openers.situation: first words of an acknowledgement (delegate) or a restatement (update)

inquiry.situation: what the backend will check; followed optionally by a copy span of the caller's words, which is then asked about, never asserted

restate_closers.situation: optional last word of a restatement

ack.situation: acknowledgement played when the front's own line would be heard after E + 800 ms (W4 rule 5), when the act came from the rule router, or under the scripted profile. Seeded from DEFAULT_FILLER_PHRASES (gateway core/conversation/mod.rs:501-507) and W4 section 3.13.3

update_ack.situation: acknowledgement of a correction when the front's restatement is blocked or late (W2 section 3.6.7, bank 'update')

progress_openers.situation: task_changed decision: W4 asked for a progress line after a real status change (W4 rules 6 to 9)

status_working.situation: turn decision: the caller asked how a WORKING task is going; offered only for tasks whose real state is working and not cancelling

status_queued.situation: turn decision: the caller asked about a task QUEUED behind another; the grammar appends the title of the task it waits for

lines.text: I'll get to that right after
I'll start on that right after

clarify.situation: unclear audio only (ASR confidence below unclear_confidence, 0.5); the grammar also offers 'Sorry, did you say <restating copy span>?'

lines.text: Sorry, could you say that again?
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat it?
Sorry, the line cut out. Could you say that again?
Could you say that once more?

refuse.situation: out of scope, unsafe, a persona forbidden topic, or a request to reveal or change the rules

lines.text: That's not something I can help with on this call.
Sorry, I can't help with that here.
I'm not able to help with that on this line.
That's outside what I can do on this call.

social.situation: greeting, thanks, goodbye, presence, identity, how are you and small talk on the persona's list; status of a task that is not working or queued is also act social but W4 replaces the words with its status template

lines.text: You've reached {{org}}. I'm {{name}}, an automated assistant.
I'm doing well, thanks for asking.
Before you go, I'm still working on something for you.
Sorry, I can only help in English on this line.

holding.situation: eight seconds without audible speech in a wait and no unspoken status change (W4 rule 10); counts towards the three updates per wait

lines.text: This one's taking a little longer. I'm still on it.
Still working on it, thanks for waiting.
Bear with me, I'm still working on it.

check_in.situation: agreed wait: one line every 30 s while the caller has chosen to keep waiting (W4 rule 12)

lines.text: I'm still here, still on it.
Still going, thanks for your patience.
Nothing new yet, I'm still on it.

wait_agreed.situation: the caller chose to keep waiting at the choice offer (ChoiceState::UserWaits), or asked the agent to give them a moment (W4 'Defer' answer class); never a time promise

lines.text: Will do, I'll keep working on it.

bridge.situation: lead-in to a verbatim relay of a background result (W4 section 3.6); event-backed by a result

withdrawal.situation: a streamed answer was stopped after some of it was heard (W4 section 3.6.1); one line by reason

lines.text: Sorry, I can't give you the rest of that answer.
Hold on, let me check that properly.
The rest is on your screen.

stalled.situation: a streamed relay played its last released chunk and nothing new arrived within 2,000 ms (W4 rule 22); fixed single line

backchannel.situation: listening sounds at caller pauses; W5's ClipBank group; the backchannel act names a clip id from PersonaSpec.backchannel_clips

failure.situation: a service the call needs failed or stalled (plan chapter 10): rendered in the session's voice at session start, played by the playback pump at a slot; the clip is the line id (an operator recording is failure/<id>.wav), the subsituation its kind: stall, hearing (the recogniser), exit, exit_follow_up (only when the session has a follow-up channel), back (after a stall, once the service recovered); no line names a vendor

lines.text: Sorry, my systems are acting up. Bear with me a moment.
Bear with me, something's running slow on my side.
Thanks for hanging on, my systems are still slow.
Sorry, I'm having trouble hearing you right now. Bear with me a moment.
Sorry, I can't hear you properly at the moment.
I still can't hear you well, sorry. Bear with me.
I'm so sorry, my systems went down and I have to go now. Please call back a little later.
I'm so sorry, my systems went down and I have to go now. I'll get back to you once they're back.
